extracted.name: Instant Pot Brown Rice
extracted.description: Learn how to cook brown rice in the Instant Pot! The process is easy and hands-off, and the rice comes out perfect every time.
instruction_lines: Combine the rinsed rice and water in a 6-quart Instant Pot. Secure the lid and Pressure Cook on High for 20 minutes.
Allow the Instant Pot to release pressure naturally. This will take 20 to 30 minutes. When the float valve drops, remove the lid.
categories: how to cook brown rice in Instant Pot
